highlights: Character stone cottage in a sought-after Eden Valley village
Flexible three-storey layout with four double bedrooms
Cosy living space with wood-burning stove
Quiet setting with open countryside to the rear
summary: Occupying a private position in this quiet and always desirable upper Eden Valley Village, handy for Lazonby and Kirkoswald, a deceptively spacious and flexible, 2 reception, 4 double bedroom sandstone cottage, with garden and pastoral views to the rear along with a range of outbuildings
description:
Offered to the market with no onward chain and presented in well-maintained, neutral décor throughout, 2 The Hill represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a charming traditional stone-built cottage in this highly sought-after fellside village in the Upper Eden Valley.

Tucked away on a quiet lane just off the heart of the village, with open fields to the rear, the accommodation is arranged over three floors. The ground floor comprises an entrance hallway with a useful walk-in pantry, a cosy sitting room featuring a Stovax wood-burning stove, a well-appointed kitchen, and a separate dining room with direct access to the garden.

To the first floor are two generous double bedrooms and a family bathroom, with further stairs leading to two additional double bedrooms within the converted attic space.

Externally, the property benefits from off-road parking to the front, together with a range of useful store rooms, the larger with power and lighting. A shared pathway provides access to the rear of the property, where a delightful cottage garden enjoys a peaceful setting.

Enjoying a peaceful and idyllic rural position, this versatile property would make an ideal primary residence, a superb weekend retreat, or a highly attractive holiday letting investment.

Directions From Penrith head through Lazonby towards Kirkoswald. Pass through the village heading up the hill and take the turning to the right signposted Renwick. Follow this for approximately 3.5 miles into Renwick itself. As you enter the village the road bends to the left. After 400 metres turn to the left just before the chapel and follow this to reach 2 The Hill

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • There is a pedestrian right of way for the neighbours at the foot of the garden.
